text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SmartRouting alert: increased fallback loop detections between eu-west and us-east impacting tool_call paths. Rule smart-route-v2 evaluated at 2026-03-15T09:12:30Z. Paging oncall.

alex.nguyen: i'm on it. quick TL;DR pls — what's the immediate failure mode?

maria.s: short: requests that require tool calling or very long contexts are being routed to llama-3-8q (quant) which fails during runtime with tool_call_unsupported or context_truncation. After failure, fallback tries llama-3-8fp16 in another region -> repeated cross-region reroutes. Snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z req=ry7 variant=llama-3-8q err=tool_call_unsupported
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z req=ry7 fallback=llama-3-8fp16 region=eu-west status=200
2026-03-15T09:14:10Z req=az2 variant=llama-3-8q err=context_truncation_required
2026-03-15T09:14:11Z req=az2 fallback=llama-3-8fp16 region=us-east status=502
```

devon_p: i can confirm a compat-matrix change went out at 2026-03-15T08:58 by config-pipeline (change: "enable tool_calling on llama-3-8q as experimental"). That flag should've been gated.

sam: customer impact: webhook delivery error spike for two paying customers (Papertrail and Lexico). Retries piling up, retries >3x baseline. CS alerted.

alex.nguyen: mitigation plan asap:
1) stop cross-region reroutes in smart-route-v2 (disable inter-region forwarding)
2) add a routing override: prefer llama-3-8fp16 when tools=true OR context_tokens > 4096
3) revert compatibility flag for llama-3-8q tool_calling in the compat matrix

maria.s: applying policy patch now. patch payload:
```
curl -X POST "$RTS_API/policies/smart-route-v2/patch" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '
{"patch":[
  {"op":"replace","path":"/cross_region_enabled","value":false},
  {"op":"add","path":"/overrides/-","value":{"predicate":"tools == true || context_tokens > 4096","preferred_variant":"llama-3-8fp16"}}
]}
'
```

ops-bot: policy patch accepted (tx=0xa3d1). snapshot smart-route-v2@2026-03-15T09:18:10Z

maria.s: patch rolled to edge clusters (3/3). monitoring telemetry.

sam: metrics: tool_call error rate 11.4% -> 1.5% within 7 minutes. fallback-loop detector count dropping. :thumbsup:

ingrid: i'll take customer comms. can we give an ETA? also need sample request ids for CS.

devon_p: tell them we deployed a mitigation and expect stabilization in ~10 minutes. collecting logs now. sample req ids saved to /mnt/incident-dumps/INC-2026-0315-07/ids.txt

alex.nguyen: next step: publish compat matrix rollback. maria, please kick the config release with a version bump.

maria.s: releasing compat matrix update: POST $INTERNAL/configs/compatibility/matrix/release payload:
{"model":"llama-3-8q","capabilities":{"tool_calling":false},"version":"v2026-03-15-compat-rollback"}

deploy-bot: compat matrix release started cfg-rel-9007, validators=5.

deploy-bot: cfg-rel-9007 applied to readers globally in 28s. new matrix v2026-03-15-compat-rollback

sam: re-run sanity checks: batch of 250 requests that previously hit 8q -> 0 tool_call errors, all routed to 8fp16 as expected.

ingrid: emailed Papertrail + Lexico: short note with status, mitigation, monitoring window. asked if they saw any persistent failures. they acknowledged and appreciate fast response.

alex.nguyen: handoff: i'll be on for another 20m then ingrid will be primary for 6h. ingrid please ack receiving runbook + logs. i'll DM you the playbook.

ingrid: ack. taking over monitoring and postmortem lead. starting a draft in #incidents-docs.

devon_p: followups assigned:
- RCA: why did config-pipeline accept experimental flag? add gate in compat CI
- Add regression test: routing-simulator to cover tool_call + long context combos
- Add alert: routing-loop-detection to fire before SLO breach
- Review canary: policy canary to avoid global cross-region reroutes without a progressive rollout
- Customer remediation: possible credits for Papertrail/Lexico if SLA impact confirmed

alex.nguyen: incident severity lowered to S2; mitigation succeeded. i'll open INC-2026-0315-07 and assign owners.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=S2, incident_id=INC-2026-0315-07. paging cleared.

maria.s: saved full logs and request dumps to /mnt/incident-dumps/INC-2026-0315-07/ (internal only). checksum: sha256:3f7a...b2

sam: reminder: monitor cross-region fallbacks for 24h. if fallback-loops >0.5% for >15m, escalate to S1.

ingrid: will draft postmortem with timeline, RCA, and action owners. planning a test matrix addition and CI gate. ping me for follow-ups.

alex.nguyen: thanks all. nice quick triage and rollback. :heart:
